Create two synthetic ContentVersion records containing a one-pixel PNG with IsAssetEnabled=true; query each resulting ContentAsset and sort the two asset IDs. Create three Prompt and PromptVersion records as in the neighboring nulls_order_prompt_user_lookup setup. For the two populated cases set ImageId to lower and higher IDs, ImageAltText=Synthetic, and ImageLocation=Top; the null case has none of these image fields. Re-query all ImageId values and label the records N, L, H. At each API version query them with ORDER BY ImageId NULLS FIRST, NULLS LAST, ASC, DESC, and DESC NULLS LAST.
